seoTitle: Exception Grouper: Cluster Similar Error Messages
metaDescription: Group error and exception lines by masking numbers, IDs, IPs, paths and URLs. See counts, first and last line and an example. Free.
intro: Replaces the variable parts of error lines with placeholders and counts each group.
why:
A log with 10,000 errors usually has a handful of causes. Masking IDs, numbers, paths, URLs and quoted values turns thousands of lines into a short list.

It works on single lines. Stack frames are skipped, and a leading timestamp is removed so equal messages group together.
howTo: Choose errors only or all lines.
Decide whether quoted values stay visible.
Read the groups from most to least frequent.

faq.a: UUIDs, IPs, URLs, long hex strings, paths, quoted values and numbers.

faq.q: Is this like the privacy workbench?
faq.a: That tool redacts private data first. This one only groups errors and keeps the original text in the example.
It groups the line that names the exception, not the whole trace.
No. Everything is processed in your browser and nothing is sent. Logs can hold IP addresses and tokens, so the page does not write them into the address bar.
